_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Digital tracking, provider decision support systems, and targeted client communication via mobile devices to improve primary health care
proposals.why: Most recent Cochrane review (18 studies) directly addressing digital tracking, CDSS, and targeted client communication in primary care.

proposals.title: Decision-support tools via mobile devices to improve quality of care in primary healthcare settings
proposals.why: Cochrane review of 8 trials on mobile CDSS for primary healthcare workers; mixed effects on health outcomes.

proposals.title: Targeted client communication via mobile devices for improving maternal, neonatal, and child health
proposals.why: Cochrane review (35 studies) on SMS/mobile reminders to patients for maternal, neonatal, and child health outcomes.

proposals.title: Health workers' perceptions and experiences of using mHealth technologies to deliver primary healthcare services: a qualitative evidence synthesis
proposals.why: Cochrane qualitative synthesis (43 studies) on health workers' experiences using mobile phones/tablets in primary care.

proposals.title: WHO guideline: recommendations on digital interventions for health system strengthening
proposals.why: First WHO evidence-based guideline on digital health; recommends digital tracking combined with decision support in primary care.

proposals.title: Computer-generated reminders delivered on paper to healthcare professionals: effects on professional practice and healthcare outcomes
proposals.why: Cochrane review on computer-generated provider reminders; moderate evidence of improved processes of care.

proposals.title: Manually-generated reminders delivered on paper: effects on professional practice and patient outcomes
proposals.why: Cochrane review on paper reminders to providers; contextual baseline for comparing digital vs. non-digital reminder effects.

proposals.title: Clients' perceptions and experiences of targeted digital communication accessible via mobile devices for reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health: a qualitative evidence synthesis
proposals.why: Cochrane qualitative synthesis on patient perspectives of mobile reminder messages; informs acceptability and implementation.
